validation.not_blind: Previous image/initialization exposure; no reserved residuals used for selecting fitting objective.
validation.before_metrics: Hard-constraint initialization from the prior published scene and independent parallel-wrist initialization; not the prior published scene itself or the optional optimization start file.

optimizer.optimality_precision: Three significant digits preserved from the solver console; original full-precision value was not serialized.
optimizer.termination_interpretation: Local step-size stopping criterion; nonzero first-order optimality and nonsmooth silhouette visibility do not establish a stationary or global optimum.

fixture.constraint_meaning: Each constant arm-base transform maps the measured SUJ pivot exactly onto a scaled CAD port; pad normal is parallel but displacement relative to feet is free. Scale and displacement are fitted, not measured.
